why_it_moved.text: The Successful Search Rate gain shrinks the longer users have had the new ranker, by about 0.1 points per day since exposure.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: Early users may react to a changed result order, and the gain settles lower as that wears off.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: If the gain by days since exposure levels off above the 0.5% bar once the planned 14 days are in, the call becomes a win.
If the gain keeps falling below the 0.5% bar through the planned 14 days, the call becomes a trade-off for triage.
A before-start comparison of the two groups would let the pre-period check run.
